findings.issue: Tienda capitalizes the common noun אֹהֶל (construct); the morphology is a common noun, not a proper name or title.
su does not mark the 3rd masculine plural suffixes on the infinitives; plural is carried only by lavarán.

notes: The remaining tokens match: anarthrous tent of meeting, approach to the altar, qal 3mp wash, as YHWH commanded Moses.
